why.heading: The Charis advantage.
why.intro: There are many makeup artists. There is only one team that does your face and your film as one coordinated vision.

items.title: Camera-Ready Beauty
items.text: We work alongside a professional film crew. Your makeup is designed to look right on camera, not just in the mirror.

items.title: Built for Uganda
items.text: Products and techniques chosen for heat, humidity and long outdoor events, so your look holds through the ceremony, the reception and the golden hour photos.

items.title: Cultural Expertise
items.text: From gomesi to mushanana, we understand traditional Ugandan beauty. We don’t make traditional attire look like a costume. We make it look like a crown.

items.title: One Team, One Vision
items.text: When you book Charis Artistry with Charis Creations film, your makeup artist and film crew work as one coordinated team. No separate briefings.

items.title: Hair + Makeup Together
items.text: No need to book separate people, coordinate separate schedules, or worry about styles that don’t match.

items.title: Touch-Up Coverage
items.text: Most packages include dedicated touch-up time. We stay through the day so you look your best in every photo.

combined.heading: Book film and makeup together.
combined.body: When Charis Creations films your wedding and Charis Artistry does your makeup, the two teams work as one. Your makeup artist knows when the cameras are rolling. Your cinematographer knows your best angles. Ask about our combined package offers.
combined.wa: Hi, I'd like to ask about combined Film + Makeup packages from Charis
